subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: After the source-reader limit defect is repaired, should OpenClaw adopt this grouped Claw v1 schema and read-only planning contract as the core foundation for the linked lifecycle stack?
rationale: The implementation creates durable CLI, environment, manifest, identity, diagnostic, and JSON-plan surfaces, while the governing RFC and immutable install-identity question remain open.

options.title: Repair and await RFC acceptance
options.body: Fix the pre-read limit boundary, add exact-head proof, and keep the PR open until maintainers accept or narrow the Claws RFC contract.

options.title: Accept the experimental contract now
options.body: Land the gated schema and planner while explicitly accepting later compatibility work if the RFC or install-identity model changes.

options.title: Pause the implementation stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent lifecycle branches until the product model and ownership boundaries are settled in the RFC.

recommendation.title: Repair and await RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Fix the pre-read limit boundary, add exact-head proof, and keep the PR open until maintainers accept or narrow the Claws RFC contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their detailed product/schema review established several boundaries now implemented by the branch, making them the strongest visible routing candidate for the remaining contract decision.
